posts.title: Forum Rules
posts.edited: Last Edit: December 04, 2008, 04:29:54 PM by KiZai
posts.html:
Hi guys.

In order for you all to enjoy your stay at the VM forums, there are a few rules that you must abide by:

1) Do not flame. If someone insults you, contact an admin - Myself, Clown, Chaz or Drewley - for help, do not retaliate as this can make you as bad as them. No forms of racism or prejudice will be tolerated.

2) Do not link to illegal material. Your post will be deleted and on further posts you may be banned.

3) Do not post or link to vulgar material without due warning. This should help minimise upset.

4) Do not revive old threads. If they have died, just let them rest.

5) Only post spam in the relevant section. This means only meaningful threads and answers should be posted, try to avoid one word ansers.

6) Do not double post. It is unnecessary; the modify button is there for a reason.

See, thats not so bad after all is it? Have fun...

-KiZai
